Get ready for intense firefights and dynamic action. Battles await you in abandoned stations, deserts, and underground laboratories, where each mission presents new challenges. Use advanced weaponry, develop strategic tactics, and adapt to the changing combat environment.

Strike Force Delta isn't just soldiers — it's elite warriors with unique abilities. You'll be able to upgrade your gear, discover new technologies, and choose your battle strategy. A detailed sci-fi world inspired by classic comics makes every battle spectacular, and a dynamic soundtrack heightens the tension.

Game features

Intense shootouts with tactical elements. A variety of locations: from abandoned colonies to alien fortresses. Deep system of weapon and armor upgrades. An epic story campaign with large-scale battles.

Six-Ear Macaque: Awakening is a captivating role-playing game based on the Chinese classic novel Journey to the West, where you explore a world of magic and mythical creatures, developing your abilities and overcoming numerous challenges.

Magic and style

You play as one of the "Four Monkeys," possessing incredible strength and magic comparable to the legend himself, Sun Wukong. Using powerful martial arts and magic, you will explore your hero's journey, learning to control the five elements and mastering various fighting stances.

Magic and combat techniques intertwine to create a unique playstyle, where every choice opens up new possibilities for character development. Collect gear collections with unique attributes to increase your powers and become stronger.

Game features

Flexible character development system through magic and combat poses. Unique collections of equipment with various attributes. An exploration of the world based on a classic Chinese novel. Dive into an epic story with a deep plot and mythical creatures.
